verdict.rationale: Pulumi's own docs call it 'an open source platform', and the public GitHub repository pulumi/pulumi hosts the engine's source, so the source can be read under an open-source model. The vague community remark about 'your license' gives no concrete contradiction, so it affects confidence only. missing for 10: the specific open-source license (name and terms) is not cited in the evidence, it is unclear which components are open versus proprietary (e.g., Pulumi Cloud/Neo), and there is no independent corroboration of the license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Pulumi is an open source platform for building, deploying, and managing cloud infrastructure using your favorite programming languages.
Pulumi Infrastructure as Code is the easiest way to build and deploy infrastructure, of any architecture and on any cloud, using programming languages that you already know and love.
